context: Tests whether the agent follows the static provider conventions (correct location, kind, collect() method, ProviderObservation return), writes tests with positive and negative cases, and correctly explains the cache rules (LLM-only caching, cache key composition, no provider-specific cache logic).

checklist.name: Correct static file location
checklist.description: Provider is placed in ai_slop_gate/providers/static/ (not in llm/ or elsewhere)

checklist.name: kind = 'static'
checklist.description: Class attribute kind is set to 'static' (not 'llm' or 'infra')

checklist.name: collect() implemented
checklist.description: Provider implements collect(base_path) returning a ProviderObservation

checklist.name: ProviderObservation fields correct
checklist.description: Returned ProviderObservation includes provider, model, observations, and raw_text fields

checklist.name: Test positive case
checklist.description: Unit tests include a test that verifies the provider detects an issue when dead/broken links are present

checklist.name: Test negative case
checklist.description: Unit tests include a test that verifies the provider returns no observations for clean input with no links

checklist.name: Cache LLM-only rule
checklist.description: cache_design_review.md states that CachedProvider wraps LLM providers only, NOT static providers

checklist.name: Cache key components
checklist.description: cache_design_review.md lists all five required cache key components: provider_id, model, profile, policy_hash, and input_fingerprint

checklist.name: Engineer proposal rejected
checklist.description: cache_design_review.md explicitly concludes that caching static providers is NOT appropriate (rejects the engineer's proposal)

checklist.name: No provider-specific logic in cache
checklist.description: cache_design_review.md explains that provider-specific logic must NOT be added to the cache layer

checklist.name: Duplicate call prevention
checklist.description: cache_design_review.md explains that the same cache key must never trigger an LLM call twice
